subject: Culture
title: Social Media Debut
description: A micro-lesson that makes Social Media Debut usable.

hook.text: Posting your first selfie online is a modern announcement: I exist. See me. I choose how you see me.

buildup.text: For Gen Z, creating an online identity is as significant as any traditional identity ritual.

discovery.text: Research shows teens curate online selves carefully. The profile is a performance, like any initiation costume.

twist.text: Parents now post children's lives from birth. Some kids arrive on social media before they can consent.

climax.text: Digital identity creation is the 21st century's coming-of-age rite. The audience is just bigger.

punchline.text: The first post is the modern naming ceremony.

quiz.question: Researchers compare the curated online profile to what traditional element?
